Walk it

Before you start

  • You need step 2.3 (Create two item groups); step 1.8 (Confirm the test design); step 1.9 (Confirm the test design); step 1.2 (Confirm the test design); step 1.5 (Confirm the test design).

Steps

Screen
Master Data➔Items➔Defaults➔Item Defaults (tcibd0102m000)

Why LN works this way. A default combination records, per package, two separate things: whether default data exists for the subentity, shown by the indicator, and whether a new item should receive it, set by the Create check box. A green indicator with the box cleared gives a new item nothing. The Sites check box decides whether new items get a site row automatically.

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
Product is unavailableConfirm the environment's Product-active setting; do not substitute Purchased or Manufactured without approval
Ordering defaults appear to require a Warehouse, but no Warehouse field is displayedVerify the warehouse on the parent tcibd0502m000 Sites row
Ordering defaults will not saveConfirm every visible required value and retain the proposed Economic Order Quantity
Purchase defaults will not saveConfirm the units, currency, price group and statistics group in the family sheet §4
Warehousing defaults show an unknown required policy valueStop and obtain the approved value; do not invent valuation, ownership, location, lot/serial, or handling-unit policy
